text:
zoe (Support): Hey team, opening here — user u-9072 signed up, verified email, added payment method via Apple Pay, 3DS shows PASS, but free-trial credits never applied. Customer says they completed signup at ~11:32 PT.
liam-payments: Can you drop the payment_method_id and the gateway response we got?
zoe (Support): pm_7k9xY. Gateway returned: ```{\n  \"bin\": \"456712\",\n  \"issuer\": \"FIRSTNAME CO\",\n  \"country\": \"US\",\n  \"3ds_status\": \"pass\"\n}``` Our grants service response: `403` with body `{"reason":"payment_method_business_name_mismatch","detail":"issuer_normalized: FIRSTNAMECO -> flagged as business"}`
ana-fraud: We rolled out a heuristic last week that treats issuers with suffixes like CO / CORP / INC as business. If issuer_normalized == billing_name_normalized mismatch -> gate. Does customer's email look personal?
zoe (Support): Email is personal (user123@gmail.com). Customer says it's a personal debit card. Billing name from gateway is `FIRSTNAME CO` (no punctuation). Customer insists their bank returns that as the merchant name on card tokenization.
liam-payments: This smells like tokenization normalization (Apple Pay sometimes returns issuer names with suffixes stripped/preserved). Could be a false positive. Quick repro steps I want: 1) run grants-check locally for u-9072 2) pull payments gateway raw payload 3) check the normalization mapping.
zoe (Support): Repro steps I ran: 1) Signup on Chrome desktop -> card via Apple Wallet -> payment_method created -> grants-check returned 403. 2) I pasted gateway raw payload (see above).
liam-payments: Can you paste the grants service log snippet?
zoe (Support): ```[2024-11-05T18:32:21Z] grants-service INFO checkGrant(user=u-9072) -> reason=payment_method_business_name_mismatch issuer_normalized=FIRSTNAMECO billing_normalized=FIRSTNAME
[2024-11-05T18:32:21Z] grants-service DEBUG payload={payment_method_id: pm_7k9xY, user_email: user123@gmail.com}```
grant-bot: Automated note: ticket CS-31942 created and escalated to payments & fraud.
nana-fraud: Triage recommendation: this is likely a false positive. We should either: A) manual grant after verifying last4/billing name from customer, or B) quick patch to loosen normalization rule for common suffixes (CO, LTD) and add monitoring. I'll take B as a follow-up.
liam-payments: I'll do a manual override for this user once we confirm last4. Zoe, please request last4 from the customer (don't ask for full card).
zoe (Support): Requested last4 — customer replied: last4 = 1234 and billing name = "Firstname Lastname". Customer confirms it's a personal card.
liam-payments: Manual grant run at 1723456845: `POST /internal/grants/manual` payload `{user:u-9072, amount:100, reason:"manual override - false positive business name"}` -> response 200. Credits applied.
nana-fraud: Filed follow-up FR to adjust normalization rules: FR-1028 (exclude issuer strings that are just trailing punctuation/suffixes when billing name is clearly personal).
customer-ops: Confirmed with customer that credits are visible. Customer happy.
zoe (Support): Closing thread. Notes: ask payments to add unit tests for issuer normalization + add one-shot dashboard for grants gated by business_name heuristic. :thumbsup: :tada:
